name: Story Ingredients
description: Everyone contributes a character, a setting, and a twist. The piles get shuffled and dealt back out, and each student writes a story from the random hand they were dealt.
playTime: ~20–25 min (most of it quiet writing time)

intro.message:
STORY INGREDIENTS

First we cook up the ingredients: everyone invents a character, a setting, and a twist.

Then the piles get shuffled and dealt back out. You'll write a story from the hand you're dealt, three ingredients invented by three different classmates.

characters.prompt: Invent a CHARACTER in a sentence or two. Give us someone worth writing about: a retired pirate ship cook, a squirrel with a five-year plan, a kid who can only tell the truth on Tuesdays...

settings.prompt: Now invent a SETTING. Where could a story happen? The last gas station before the desert, a school gym during a blackout, the inside of a vending machine...

twists.prompt: Last ingredient: invent a TWIST, something that suddenly happens or turns out to be true. It starts raining frogs. The map was upside down the whole time. The narrator is the villain...

share.message: Story time. One dealt hand at a time.

end.message: Same class, same piles, completely different stories. Run it again tomorrow and the deal will be different.
